group.label: Access Token Generation
group.comment: MPI V3 credentials. The Establishment Code, Merchant Name and MCC required by the MPI V3 AUTH request are read from the Global Settings section (fields Merchant Name, Establishment Code and MCC). Configure them there and this section only holds the Client ID / Client Secret.

field.label: Client ID
field.comment: Authentication 3DS 2.x (MPI V3) Client ID. Contact Braspag to get your own Client ID.

field.label: Client Secret
field.comment: Authentication 3DS 2.x (MPI V3) Client Secret. Contact Braspag to get your own Client Secret.

field.label: Debug Log
field.comment: When enabled, every AUTH / INIT / ENROLL / VALIDATE call is written to var/log/braspag_mpi_v3.log with request URL, redacted headers, body (PAN masked), HTTP status, response body and, when applicable, the parsed status, reasonCode, challenge and authentication blocks. Keep OFF in production once the integration is validated.
